lines: Your lat pulldown might be skipping your lats...
and most people do both of these.
pulling the bar behind your neck.
Pulling to your chest works your lats as well or better...
and it's easier on your shoulders.
swinging way back to move the weight.
A small lean, about twenty degrees, is plenty...
past that, momentum does the work.
myths: Pulling the bar behind your neck
Swinging way back to move the weight
h2:
TO THE CHEST =
SAME OR MORE LATS
